w = 2π·2·t gives 2 Hz. Inner angle is 0.6·sin(w), outer angle is 0.5·sin(w − 0.7), so the outer segment lags by 0.7 rad.
bobGroup.position.y = 0.12·sin(w + π/2 − 0.3) uses the same flap phase w, so the bob is locked to the flap.
Position is (6cos a, 4, 6sin a) with a = 2πt/8, giving radius 6 and an 8 s period. rotation.y = −a maps model +Z to (−sin a, cos a), which is the path tangent.
